chunks: All those among you who turned their backs on the day the two armies clashed (at 'Uhud) were surely induced by Satan to fail in their duty because of their sinful deeds. But God has already forgiven them, for God is forgiving and kind.

key_terms.يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ: the day the two armies clashed (Battle of Uhud)

ai.seo_question: Why did the Muslims flee at the Battle of Uhud and how did God forgive them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for understanding the psychological and spiritual dynamics of the Battle of Uhud, where Satan exploited the Companions' minor sins to cause a temporary lapse in discipline. It underscores the concept of divine pardon (Afw) rather than strict retribution, affirming that their eventual steadfastness validated their faith despite the momentary weakness.
